about: PlayStation Plus Extra/Deluxe/Premium subscribers: This title is available in the PlayStation Plus Game Catalogue, and you may redeem it from your PS4 or PS5 console. (Redemption from web/mobile is currently unavailable.)

TowerFall Ascension is the definitive version of the hit archery combat game. Inspired by classics from the golden age of couch multiplayer, it's a local party game centering around hilarious, intense versus matches.

The core mechanics are simple and accessible, but hard to master and combat is fierce. Loot treasure chests for game-changing power-ups, master the art of catching arrows out of the air, or descend on your foes and stomp them into submission.
TowerFall is best played competitively with friends, cross-legged on the floor within punching distance of each other.
New in Ascension is the 1- or 2-player co-op Quest mode. Players work together, fighting off a variety of monsters and enemy archers across the land of TowerFall.
It's a new adventure to explore when you don't have more friends handy to square off against.
